Week 2 In-Class Activity

Week 2 — In-Class Timed Activity

ECN 4199 — Industrial Data Analytics

Activity Information

Item Details
Week Week 2
Topic Python Setup, Google Colab, VS Code, and Working with Real Data
Marks 5 Marks
Duration 1 Hour
Attempts One Attempt Only
Access Lecturer Passcode Required

Instructions

  1. Open the Week 2 live notebook.
  2. Save a copy to your Google Drive.
  3. Complete all required tasks.
  4. Answer all interpretation questions.
  5. Submit before the activity closes.

Important Reminder

This activity tests:

  • ability to use Google Colab
  • ability to load datasets
  • basic pandas usage
  • dataset interpretation
  • understanding of computational workflows

This is NOT a memorisation exercise.

Task 1 — Opening the Notebook

Objective

Ensure the notebook environment works correctly.

Instructions

Run the following code:

print("Week 2 activity started successfully")

Question

What is the advantage of cloud-based coding environments such as Google Colab?

Write 2–3 sentences.

Task 2 — Importing pandas

Objective

Load the main data analysis library.

Instructions

Import pandas using the correct syntax.

Expected Structure

import pandas as pd

Question

Why do economists and analysts use libraries instead of writing everything from scratch?

Task 3 — Loading the Dataset

Objective

Load the Sri Lankan macroeconomic dataset.

Instructions

Upload the provided CSV file into Colab.

Then run:

data = pd.read_csv("sri_lanka_macro.csv")

Question

What does CSV stand for?

Task 4 — Exploring the Dataset

Objective

Inspect the structure of the dataset.

Instructions

Run the following commands:

data.head()

and

data.info()

Questions

Question 1

How many variables are included in the dataset?

Question 2

Are there missing values?

Question 3

Which variable appears to have the largest numerical values?

Task 5 — Summary Statistics

Objective

Generate basic statistical summaries.

Instructions

Run:

data.describe()

Questions

Question 1

Which year had the highest inflation?

Question 2

What happened to GDP growth in 2022?

Question 3

What happened to the exchange rate between 2021 and 2022?

Write short interpretations.

Task 6 — Reflection Question

Write a short paragraph answering:

Why is Python more useful than manually analysing large datasets in Excel?

Your answer should include:

  • automation
  • reproducibility
  • scalability
  • data handling

Mini Quiz

Question 1

What does CSV stand for?

A. Central Statistical Variable
B. Comma-Separated Values
C. Computer Statistical Verification
D. Column Sorted Values

Question 2

Which library is mainly used for data handling?

A. matplotlib
B. numpy
C. pandas
D. sklearn

Question 3

What does head() do?

A. Deletes rows
B. Creates graphs
C. Displays first rows
D. Saves dataset

Question 4

Which command imports pandas?

import pandas as pd
load pandas
pandas.open()
import data

Common Errors

Problem 1 — File Not Found

Possible causes:

  • dataset not uploaded
  • incorrect filename

Problem 2 — Forgetting Quotes

Wrong:

pd.read_csv(sri_lanka_macro.csv)

Correct:

pd.read_csv("sri_lanka_macro.csv")

Problem 3 — Forgetting Import Statement

Wrong:

data = pd.read_csv("file.csv")

without importing pandas first.

Correct:

import pandas as pd
